en-US.fullDescription: FitLog gives Alexa+ a memory for your training life. Log sets by voice right after your last rep ("log my bench press: 5 reps at 185 pounds"), ask for your personal records and estimated one-rep maxes, get today's plan from your training split, and track protein toward your daily target. Your data lives in your own self-hosted database; Alexa+ connects over the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP, MCP 2025-11-25) with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE account linking, so only you can read or write your log.
